reason: Optimize the user's original weeks-to-one-month horizon, not repeated thirty-minute mark-to-market profits. Prior24 intraday replay stays unchanged.
data: Seed HFQ technical history and actual raw daily OHLC. Six currently chosen surviving tech ETFs, not historical unbiased constituents. Signals only from completed prior-session daily data. Entry and scheduled exit at actual next-session open, 100-share lots; raw price net PnL, commission and adverse slippage on both sides. Dividend cash is not invented: adjustment events during a holding period are flagged and exclude deployment eligibility.
training: Annual models use only labels whose20-session exit occurred by priorDec31. No shuffled split or automatic early stopping. Fit2023 on labels matured by2022-12-31; choose strategy only from2023 net account returns/drawdown/trade count. Freeze selected policy before opening2024-2026 portfolio outcomes. All these broad years have been examined before, so retrospective development evidence, never claim a new blind test.
selectionCriterion: From2023, choose a trained candidate with positive net account return, >=9 closed positions, positive profit factor, and not all-cash. Maximize net return minus1.5*max drawdown; keep the old baseline regardless. Freeze the single chosen policy before test outcomes. If none qualifies, explicitly reject all; do not expand grid in this experiment.
deploymentGate: No automatic deployment solely from these reused historical years. Require positive evidence on net returns, drawdown, nonzero closed trades, cost-matched simple baselines and prospective validation. All cash does not count as prediction success. If model candidates fail, retain their losses and improve the evidence/decision interface without claiming improved prediction.
limitations: Historical development, not new untouched forward performance
Daily opens do not verify limit order queues or slippage
Price-only labels exclude actual cash distributions; adjustment periods must be disclosed
Scores are not calibrated probability or70% profit assurance
